headline: Fuel prices jump: Fuel prices increase by Tk 20 per litre across the board
summary: Diesel, petrol, octane, and kerosene prices have all risen by Tk 20 per litre, effective from Monday, September 21.
details: Fuel prices in Bangladesh have increased by Tk 20 per litre for diesel, petrol, octane, and kerosene, effective from Monday, September 21.
According to a notification from the Energy and Mineral Resources Division, the new prices are: diesel at Tk 135, kerosene at Tk 155, petrol at Tk 160, and octane at Tk 165 per litre.
The government cited rising international fuel prices and freight charges due to ongoing wars in the Middle East as the primary reasons for the hike.
The Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation (BPC) reportedly suffered a loss of approximately Tk 22,875.66 crore from March to August.
The notification stated that BPC is currently losing about Tk 89 per litre on diesel alone, with daily losses amounting to approximately Tk 109 crore.
It is estimated that the price increase of Tk 20 per litre will reduce BPC's annual losses by approximately Tk 10,000 crore.
caption:
Fuel prices are up by Tk 20 per litre across the board. Here is the breakdown of the new rates.

Fuel prices in Bangladesh have increased by Tk 20 per litre for diesel, petrol, octane, and kerosene, effective from Monday, September 21.

According to a notification from the Energy and Mineral Resources Division, the new prices are: diesel at Tk 135, kerosene at Tk 155, petrol at Tk 160, and octane at Tk 165 per litre.

The government cited rising international fuel prices and freight charges due to ongoing wars in the Middle East as the primary reasons for the hike.

The Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation (BPC) reportedly suffered a loss of approximately Tk 22,875.66 crore from March to August.

The notification stated that BPC is currently losing about Tk 89 per litre on diesel alone, with daily losses amounting to approximately Tk 109 crore.

It is estimated that the price increase of Tk 20 per litre will reduce BPC's annual losses by approximately Tk 10,000 crore.

headline: MP Gazi Nazrul's second wife found dead in NAM flat
summary: The MP and his first wife have been taken into custody for questioning after the body was recovered from the apartment.
details: The body of the second wife of MP Gazi Nazrul Islam, representing Satkhira-4, was recovered from a flat in the NAM building in Dhaka.
Following the discovery, police took MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife into custody for questioning.
A case has been filed against the MP and two other individuals in connection with the woman's death.
Authorities are continuing their investigation to determine the exact cause of death and the circumstances surrounding the incident.
caption:
An MP's second wife found dead in a Dhaka flat; the MP and his first wife are now in police custody.

The body of the second wife of MP Gazi Nazrul Islam, representing Satkhira-4, was recovered from a flat in the NAM building in Dhaka.

Following the discovery, police took MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife into custody for questioning.

A case has been filed against the MP and two other individuals in connection with the woman's death.

Authorities are continuing their investigation to determine the exact cause of death and the circumstances surrounding the incident.
